items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: If you've noticed, a lot of my records, I featured Bobby Johnson, after Dud, and all the rest of the names on there.

ctx.x: Like, when I got to New York, certain people said that I should be taking this solo. I should do it, I was bringing in Dud Bascomb and the other trumpet players in the band. I said no, let them take one too. Let them play. If they can play a solo, whoever it is, let them feature.

If you've noticed, a lot of my records, I featured Bobby Johnson, after Dud, and all the rest of the names on there. They played too. But, if I, I just can't take nothing from nobody. If I know he's got that ability,
they've got to be there. And, I just feel good for people. As long as a person is a person and he feels good and he can do this, if I can help, more power to him.
